rationale: B has a more distinctive art direction (ruled ledger-paper background, editorial serif with italic vermilion accents) and a richer hero, where a masked serif headline reveal is staggered with the live code/ledger panel. A's acid-green dark SaaS look is competent but generic, and its hero leaves the right half empty. On scroll, B tells a pinned four-step 'one payment, four moves' story with stepping flow-diagram states and dense, finished sections throughout. A's step sequence is solid, but several desktop viewports (around 8100-9450px) are mostly empty dark space with headings cut off at the fold, and a stray beige band appears in both its desktop and mobile frames. A's hover states (lime-to-white fill with glow, outline pills) are bolder than B's underline and darken treatment, but that does not make up for the gap elsewhere.
